title: Village Drama & Sports Event Poster Maker
title_te: ఊరి నాటకం & ఆటల పోటీల పోస్టర్ మేకర్
problem: Village festival dramas and kabaddi matches get small audiences because organisers cannot afford printing-shop announcement posters.
idea: Free, bright event posters made in Canva with catchy lines from Gemini, for noticeboards and WhatsApp groups. Pick an event to get a catchy line, and check your poster before sharing.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Pick your event
widgets.question: What is happening in our village?

options.label: Kabaddi match
options.result: Kabaddi! Kabaddi! Come cheer for our village team this Sunday!
options.te: కబడ్డీ! కబడ్డీ! ఈ ఆదివారం మన ఊరి జట్టును ప్రోత్సహించండి!

options.label: Village drama
options.result: A night of stories, songs and laughter — our village drama is here!
options.te: కథలు, పాటలు, నవ్వులతో మన ఊరి నాటకం వచ్చేసింది!

options.label: Cricket tournament
options.result: Bats ready, balls ready — village cricket cup starts now!
options.te: బ్యాట్లు రెడీ, బంతులు రెడీ — ఊరి క్రికెట్ కప్ మొదలైంది!

options.label: Festival fair
options.result: Come with family! Games, food and fun at our village fair.
options.te: కుటుంబంతో రండి! ఆటలు, తిండి, సరదా — మన ఊరి జాతరలో.

bands.text: Nearly there — add the missing details.
Important details are missing. People won't know when or where to come.

items.title: Big and bold
items.text: People should read the event name from 3 metres away.

items.title: Two or three colours
items.text: Use dark text on a light background. Don't use too many colours.

items.title: Share smart
items.text: Download as an image for WhatsApp and print a few for the noticeboard.

how: Collect the event details: name, date, time, place, organiser and phone number.
Ask Gemini for 3 catchy announcement lines in Telugu and English.
Open Canva and search 'event poster' or 'sports poster'. Pick a bright template.
Replace the text with your details and add a photo or icon (kabaddi, drama mask).
Use the checklist above, and ask an elder to check spellings.
Download as PNG for WhatsApp and PDF to print a few copies for the noticeboard.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in a Telangana village. Write 3 short, catchy poster lines in Telugu and English to invite everyone to a [kabaddi match / village drama] on [date] at [place]. Keep them fun and respectful.
